chinese: definitely true or certain 不可否认的；无可争辩的
examples: e.g. The link between poverty and bad health is [[undeniable]].

chinese: ordinary and not interesting or exciting 平凡的；平淡的；乏味的
examples: e.g. The [[mundane]] task of setting the table can be fun on holidays.

chinese: [U] 咸猪肉；熏猪肉

examples: e.g. She listened to the speaker with [[rapt]] attention.

chinese: feel or express great surprise or admiration at sth., esp. sb.'s behavior （尤指对他人的行为）感到惊讶；钦佩；赞美
examples: e.g. I [[marvel]] at my mother's ability to remain calm in crisis.

chinese: [C] 应用程序；应用软件
1) put sb. in a situation where they are not protected from sth. dangerous or unpleasant 使暴露（于险境）；使置身（于危险）当中

chinese: 2) show sth. that is usu. covered or hidden 显露；露出（通常掩盖或隐藏的东西）
examples: e.g. The report revealed that workers had been [[exposed]] to high levels of radiation.；e.g. He lifted his T-shirt to [[expose]] a scar across his chest.

chinese: 1) not protected from attack 无保护的；易受攻击的
examples: e.g. These developments leave the company in an [[exposed]] position.；e.g. This side of the garden is [[exposed]] to wind.

chinese: 2) not protected from the weather 无遮蔽的；不挡风雨的
examples: e.g. These developments leave the company in an [[exposed]] position.；e.g. This side of the garden is [[exposed]] to wind.

chinese: 1) [C] any of the long threads that carry messages between the brain and parts of the body, enabling you to move, feel pain, etc. 神经
examples: e.g. She was diagnosed with a rare condition which affected the [[nerves]] in her back.；e.g. Sean drank a large glass of brandy to calm his [[nerves]].

chinese: 2) (~s) [pl.] feelings of worry or anxiety 神经紧张；焦虑不安
examples: e.g. She was diagnosed with a rare condition which affected the [[nerves]] in her back.；e.g. Sean drank a large glass of brandy to calm his [[nerves]].

chinese: 1) the state of being human rather than an animal or machine 人性
examples: e.g. When we're in touch with our common [[humanity]], we remember that feelings of disappointment are universal.；e.g. We want a clean environment for all [[humanity]].

chinese: 2) people in general 人；人类（总称）
examples: e.g. When we're in touch with our common [[humanity]], we remember that feelings of disappointment are universal.；e.g. We want a clean environment for all [[humanity]].

chinese: 1) (~ with / between / among) the activity of talking to other people, working together with them, etc. 交流
examples: e.g. The researchers watch through a two-way mirror the [[interaction]] between mother and child in a small room.；e.g. Price is determined through the [[interaction]] of demand and supply.

chinese: 2) a process by which two or more things affect each other 相互影响；相互作用
examples: e.g. The researchers watch through a two-way mirror the [[interaction]] between mother and child in a small room.；e.g. Price is determined through the [[interaction]] of demand and supply.

chinese: 1) lacking any human qualities in a way that seems strange or frightening （怪异、恐怖而）异于人类的
examples: e.g. I quit this [[inhuman]] job. I don't want to work for a machine.；e.g. The prisoners had suffered [[inhuman]] treatment.

chinese: 2) very cruel or without any normal feelings of pity 残暴的；无同情心的
examples: e.g. I quit this [[inhuman]] job. I don't want to work for a machine.；e.g. The prisoners had suffered [[inhuman]] treatment.

chinese: make sb. feel that they cannot think clearly or do not understand 使困惑；把（某人）弄糊涂
examples: e.g. I understand the text but the diagrams are [[confusing]] me.

chinese: unclear and difficult to understand 令人困惑的；模糊不清的；难懂的
examples: e.g. The road signs were very [[confusing]] and we ended up getting lost.

chinese: in a way that appears to have a particular quality when this may or may not be true 看上去；表面上；外观上
examples: e.g. The new minister was faced with a [[seemingly]] impossible task.

chinese: conflicting ideas, beliefs, opinions, etc. cannot exist together or both be true （想法、信仰、观点等）冲突的，矛盾的
examples: e.g. It can be difficult to balance the [[conflicting]] demands for our time.

chinese: 1) express annoyance or disappointment about sth. that you think is unsatisfactory or unfair 抱怨
examples: e.g. He [[lamented]] that people had expected too much of him.；e.g. The nation [[lamented]] the death of its great leader.

chinese: 2) express feelings of great sadness about sth. （为···）悲痛，痛惜
examples: e.g. He [[lamented]] that people had expected too much of him.；e.g. The nation [[lamented]] the death of its great leader.

chinese: (fml.) seeming to be everywhere — sometimes used humorously 似乎无处不在的（有时为幽默手法）
examples: e.g. He is as recognizable and as [[ubiquitous]] as the celebrities he photographs.

chinese: very modern 先进的
examples: e.g. Modern armies consist of fewer soldiers and more [[advanced]] weapon systems.

chinese: 1) (~ sb's imagination / attention, etc.) make sb. feel very interested in sth. 引起某人想象；吸引某人注意等
examples: e.g. His stories of foreign adventure [[captured]] my imagination.；e.g. Government troops have succeeded in [[capturing]] the rebel leader.

chinese: 2) catch a person and keep them as a prisoner 俘虏；逮捕
examples: e.g. His stories of foreign adventure [[captured]] my imagination.；e.g. Government troops have succeeded in [[capturing]] the rebel leader.

chinese: [C] a group of people or things that are all of the same type 类别；种类；范畴
examples: e.g. Seats are available in ten price [[categories]].

chinese: (BrE categorise) put people or things into groups according to the type of person or thing they are 对···进行分类；把···归类
examples: e.g. The population is [[categorized]] according to age, sex, and social group.

chinese: [C] a particular way of thinking about a problem or subject 观点；看法；见解
examples: e.g. From a practical [[viewpoint]], I'd advise you not to go.

chinese: 1) give sb. the information and skills that they need to do sth. 使有能力；使能够胜任
examples: e.g. We [[equip]] students with the skills they will need once they leave college.；e.g. They spent a lot of money [[equipping]] the school with new computers.

chinese: 2) provide a person or place with the things that are needed for a particular kind of activity or work 装备；配备
examples: e.g. We [[equip]] students with the skills they will need once they leave college.；e.g. They spent a lot of money [[equipping]] the school with new computers.

chinese: 1) [C] sth. that you notice when watching sb. / sth. 观察结果
examples: e.g. Some interesting [[observations]] emerged from this research.；e.g. Most information was collected by direct [[observation]] of the animals' behavior.

chinese: 2) [C, U] the process of watching sb. / sth. carefully for a period of time 观察；注意；监视
examples: e.g. Some interesting [[observations]] emerged from this research.；e.g. Most information was collected by direct [[observation]] of the animals' behavior.

chinese: n.(~s) [pl.] the way in which things or people behave, react, and affect each other 动态；（事物或人）相互作用的方式
examples: e.g. He did research on group [[dynamics]] and leadership styles.；e.g. These countries are characterized by highly [[dynamic]] economies.；e.g. We're looking for someone positive and [[dynamic]].

chinese: a.1) continuously moving or changing 不断移动的；不断变化的；动态的
examples: e.g. He did research on group [[dynamics]] and leadership styles.；e.g. These countries are characterized by highly [[dynamic]] economies.；e.g. We're looking for someone positive and [[dynamic]].

chinese: 2) full of energy and new ideas, and determined to succeed 精力充沛的；有创新思想的；志在成功的
examples: e.g. He did research on group [[dynamics]] and leadership styles.；e.g. These countries are characterized by highly [[dynamic]] economies.；e.g. We're looking for someone positive and [[dynamic]].

chinese: a remark or event that is revealing shows you sth. interesting or surprising about a situation or sb.'s character 揭露真相的；揭示内情的
examples: e.g. The document provided a [[revealing]] insight into the way government works.

chinese: (only before noun) happening sometimes but not often or regularly 偶尔的；不经常的
examples: e.g. He spent five years in Paris, with [[occasional]] visits to Italy.

chinese: 1) if two things intertwine, or if they are intertwined, they are twisted together （使）缠绕；（使）交织在一起
examples: e.g. He told us a story in which the present and the past [[intertwined]].；e.g. Her fate [[intertwined]] with his.

chinese: 2) if two situations, ideas, etc. are intertwined, they are closely related to each other （使）（局势、观点等）紧密相关
examples: e.g. He told us a story in which the present and the past [[intertwined]].；e.g. Her fate [[intertwined]] with his.

chinese: without a pause or interruption 持续地；不间断地
examples: e.g. He has lived and worked in France almost [[continuously]] since 1990.

chinese: [C] (BrE mobile phone) 移动电话；手机

chinese: not considered to be modern or fashionable anymore 旧式的；老式的；过时的
examples: e.g. His idea is regarded as rather [[old-fashioned]].

chinese: [C, U] if there is a possibility that sth. is true or that sth. will happen, it might be true or it might happen 可能；可能性
examples: e.g. There is always a [[possibility]] that he might go back to Seattle.

chinese: [C, U] the act of making a computer, machine, or piece of software better and able to do more things （计算器、机器、软件的）升级

chinese: [U] the process that a mobile phone uses when it is in a different country or area from usual, and has to connect to a different network （手机）漫游

examples: e.g. The system [[transmits]] information over digital phone lines.

chinese: [C, usu. pl.] a gas or other substance that is sent into the air 排放物；散发物
examples: e.g. The government has decided to clean up industrial [[emissions]].

chinese: 1) [C] a place where waste is buried under the ground 废弃物填埋场

examples: e.g. [[Toxic]] chemicals have been spilled into the river for the past three months.

chinese: an action, event, etc. that is decisive has a big effect on the way that sth. develops 决定性的；关键性的
examples: e.g. It is the chief executive's opinion that is ultimately [[decisive]].

chinese: at a time that is not fixed 任何时候
examples: e.g. They should arrive [[anytime]] between noon and 3 p.m.

chinese: free sb. from feelings or conditions that make their life unhappy or difficult 使自由；使摆脱束缚
examples: e.g. Writing poetry [[liberated]] her from the routine of everyday life.

chinese: having such a great effect on you that you feel confused and do not know how to react 难以抗拒的；令人不知所措的
examples: e.g. She felt an [[overwhelming]] desire to tell someone about what had happened.

chinese: [C] sth. difficult or worrying that you are responsible for 重担；负担
examples: e.g. His family responsibilities have started to become a [[burden]].

chinese: [C, U] (~ to do sth.) a strong desire to have or do sth. even though you know you should not 引诱；诱惑
examples: e.g. Resist the [[temptation]] to buy the item until you're certain you need it.

chinese: [U] when sb. / sth. is present in a particular place 出席；到场；存在
examples: e.g. Your [[presence]] is requested at the club meeting on Friday.

chinese: [C] sb. who sees a crime, accident or other event and can describe what happened （罪案、事故、事件的）目击者
examples: e.g. According to [[witnesses]], the thief escaped through the bedroom window.

chinese: interrupt sb. or become involved in their private affairs, in an annoying and unwanted way 打扰；干涉
examples: e.g. Would I be [[intruding]] if I came with you?

chinese: affecting sb's private life or interrupting them in an unwanted and annoying way 干涉的；打扰的
examples: e.g. Some residents of the island found the presence of the film crew too [[intrusive]].

chinese: [U] the ability to continue waiting or doing sth. for a long time without becoming angry or anxious （持续等待或长时间做某事的）耐心
examples: e.g. Teaching children with special needs requires [[patience]] and understanding.

chinese: [U] the ability to understand other people's feelings and problems 同情；同感；共鸣
examples: e.g. The nurse should try to develop [[empathy]] between herself and the patient.

chinese: [U, sing.] a feeling of liking or love and caring 喜爱；钟爱；慈爱
examples: e.g. She looked back on those days with [[affection]].

chinese: [U] quiet serious thinking about sth. 沉思；冥想；默想
examples: e.g. The monks spend an hour on [[contemplation]] each morning.

chinese: (~ for / to) extremely important and necessary 极其重要的；必不可少的
examples: e.g. It is becoming almost [[essential]] for students to learn a second language.

chinese: if you fulfil a hope, wish, or aim, you achieve the thing that you hoped for, wished for, etc. 实现（希望、愿望、目标等）
examples: e.g. Visiting Disneyland has [[fulfilled]] my boyhood dream.

chinese: making you feel happy and satisfied because you are doing interesting, useful, or important things 令人满意的
examples: e.g. Each of these courses is academically challenging and personally [[fulfilling]].

chinese: able to exist or be used together without causing problems 可共存的；可兼用的
examples: e.g. Are measures to protect the environment [[compatible]] with economic growth?

chinese: [U] the feeling of being grateful 感激（之情）
examples: e.g. I would like to express my [[gratitude]] to everyone for their hard work.

chinese: relating to Greece, its people, or its language 希腊的；希腊人的；希腊语的

examples: e.g. We need someone who can [[anticipate]] and respond to changes in the fashion industry.

chinese: 1) serious, important, or useful 严肃的；重要的；有用的
examples: e.g. They want a chance to do [[meaningful]] work.；e.g. These statistics are not [[meaningful]] to anyone but a scientist.

chinese: 2) having a meaning that is easy to understand and makes sense 有意义的；浅显易懂的
examples: e.g. They want a chance to do [[meaningful]] work.；e.g. These statistics are not [[meaningful]] to anyone but a scientist.

chinese: so interested or involved in sth. that you do not notice anything else 极感兴趣的；全神贯注的；专注的
examples: e.g. Judith was totally [[absorbed]] in her book.

chinese: [U] the ability to control your mind and body in order to achieve sth. that you want to do 毅力；意志力
examples: e.g. It took all his [[willpower]] to remain calm.

chinese: [C] sb. who owns sth. 所有人；物主；业主
examples: e.g. The police have been unable to trace the [[owner]] of the vehicle.

chinese: 1) make it certain that sth. will happen 使必然发生；确保
examples: e.g. The process of training does not automatically [[guarantee]] you a job.；e.g. I [[guarantee]] you will love this film.

chinese: 2) promise to do sth. or promise that sth. will happen 保证
examples: e.g. The process of training does not automatically [[guarantee]] you a job.；e.g. I [[guarantee]] you will love this film.

chinese: tie sb. / sth. so that they cannot move or are held together firmly 捆绑；系
examples: e.g. They bound the package with brightly colored ribbons.

chinese: close or join together the two parts of sth; become closed or joined together （使两部分）系牢，扎牢，结牢，扣紧
examples: e.g. I was so fat that my skirt wouldn't [[fasten]].

chinese: 1) (not before noun) an experience, situation, etc. that is unreal seems so strange that you think you must be imagining it 不真实的；虚幻的
examples: e.g. It seemed [[unreal]] to be talking to someone so famous.；e.g. Many people have [[unreal]] expectations of what marriage will be like.

chinese: 2) not related to real things that happen 脱离现实的；不切实际的
examples: e.g. It seemed [[unreal]] to be talking to someone so famous.；e.g. Many people have [[unreal]] expectations of what marriage will be like.

chinese: 1) if you disconnect or become disconnected from your feelings, family, society, etc., you no longer feel you belong or have a relationship with them （使）脱离（关系）；（使）不联系
examples: e.g. Divorced men can too easily become [[disconnected]] from their children.；e.g. You should pay attention to [[disconnecting]] the machine from the mains first.

chinese: 2) remove the supply of power, gas, water, etc. from a machine or piece of equipment 切断（机器或设备）的电力（煤气、水）等供应
examples: e.g. Divorced men can too easily become [[disconnected]] from their children.；e.g. You should pay attention to [[disconnecting]] the machine from the mains first.

chinese: make sb. feel certain that sth. is true 使确信；使信服
examples: e.g. Her arguments didn't [[convince]] everyone, but changes were made.

chinese: (not before noun) feeling certain that sth. is true 确信的；信服的
examples: e.g. I was [[convinced]] that we were doing the right thing.

chinese: completely different in attitudes, opinions, etc. （观点、态度等）有天壤之别
examples: e.g. On the surface, they look the same. But in reality, they are [[worlds apart]].

chinese: give or leave sth. to people who will live after you 传给（后代）
examples: e.g. The ring was [[handed down]] to her from her grandmother.

english: hang on sb.'s every word / words
chinese: pay close attention to everything sb. is saying 倾听（注意）某人每一个字 / 说的话
examples: e.g. She was watching him, hanging on his every word.

chinese: want sth. very much, esp. when it seems unlikely to happen soon 渴望；盼望
examples: e.g. These were the words she had secretly longed to hear.

chinese: mention sth. that makes sb. upset, angry, or embarrassed, esp. accidentally （尤指无心地）触到敏感话题，触到痛处
examples: e.g. You [[touched]] a raw nerve when you mentioned his first wife.

chinese: show the most typical qualities of sb. / sth., esp. in a few words 简而言之；概括
examples: e.g. For me, the novel summed up the major problems of human existence.

chinese: separate sth. into smaller parts so that it is easier to do or understand 拆分；把···分成若干部分（以方便做或理解）
examples: e.g. The question can be broken down into two parts.

chinese: used when you want to give the main point of sth. 总而言之；简单地说
examples: e.g. His novels belong to a great but vanished age. They are, [[in short]], old-fashioned.

chinese: become involved with and try to understand sb. / sth. 与···建立密切关系；尽力理解
examples: e.g. Are you so tired that you don't have the energy to [[engage with]] your kids?

chinese: if sb. such as a doctor or engineer is on call, they are ready to go and help whenever they are needed as part of their job （医生、工程师等）待命，随叫随到
examples: e.g. Don't worry, there is a doctor [[on call]] 24 hours a day.

chinese: show that sth. is true or exists 见证（某事）；（为某事）证明
examples: e.g. The empty workshops [[bear witness]] to the industrial past.

english: on the contrary / quite the contrary
chinese: used to add to a negative statement, to disagree with a negative statement by sb. else, or to answer no to a question 正相反；恰恰相反
examples: e.g. It wasn't a good thing; [[on the contrary]] it was a huge mistake.
